{{cmavo|xo'a|XOhA|Loglan toggle: Toggles text to TLI Loglan; marks following text as TLI Loglan; Lojban equivalent of experimental Loglan <nowiki><hoa></nowiki> (which toggles text to Lojban)}}
*'''xo'a''' is used in Lojban to toggle to Loglan text. <nowiki><hoa></nowiki> is used in Loglan to toggle to Lojban text.
*The '''o''' and '''a''' are the vowels of ''Loglan'' and ''Lojban''.
See also http://groups.yahoo.com/group/lojban/message/1999
